name: Swiss minimal
direction: Swiss modernist identity. Design an exceptionally simple geometric capital B monogram, with a rectangular docking slot carved from its negative space. A single device block fits into that slot. Strong proportions, precise grid, flat navy #132B45 with teal #19A6A0 accent. Bespoke clean sans-serif Berth wordmark.

name: Nautical modern
direction: Contemporary maritime identity, not a generic anchor. A top-down abstract sheltered harbor with a single small boat securely berthed inside a U-shaped dock. Reduce the boat and dock to three or four elegant geometric shapes. Deep ocean blue #123B5D and seafoam #66C7B4. Refined humanist sans-serif Berth wordmark.

name: Developer-native
direction: Developer tooling identity. Two bold code brackets form a protective docking cradle around a small upright rounded rectangular device, with one tiny connection dot. Distinctive asymmetric silhouette. Flat charcoal #20242C and lime #B7E34B. Precise technical monospace Berth wordmark, welcoming rather than hacker cliche.

name: Modular geometric
direction: Bauhaus-inspired modular identity. Four or five rectangular device tiles create a distinctive capital B silhouette with clear separation representing leased slots in a fleet. Strong geometric construction and playful orderly rhythm. Flat cobalt #2855D9, warm coral #EE735C, and charcoal #202839. Geometric sans-serif Berth wordmark.

name: Monoline
direction: Elegant monoline identity. One continuous evenly weighted navy line draws a docking cradle flowing into an upright device outline, subtly suggesting lowercase b. Very few bends, rounded terminals, ample negative space, one small turquoise connection point. Navy #18374B and turquoise #22B8AA. Light but confidently readable lowercase berth wordmark.

name: Bold industrial
direction: Bold industrial infrastructure identity. A heavy custom capital B mark built like a steel docking clamp, with functional stencil cuts and one inset rectangular device slot. Compact robust silhouette, sophisticated utility, no distress or texture. Near-black #192320 with safety orange #F57C32. Wide bold engineered Berth wordmark.

name: Retro computing
direction: Tasteful 1980s computing identity. Crisp pixel-grid symbol depicting a device snapped into a dock, with a clever capital B silhouette. Deliberate stair-step edges, limited shapes, authentic 8-bit geometry without game scenery. Dark charcoal #22262A and phosphor green #43BC7C. Distinct custom pixel-font Berth wordmark with excellent legibility.

name: Friendly mascot
direction: Friendly flat-vector mascot identity. A charming small tugboat with a device-shaped cabin and a subtle smiling front window, drawn with thick clean navy outlines. Minimal shapes, confident compact character suitable for a tiny app icon, not an elaborate illustration. Navy #1C344D, warm amber #F1B54A, sea teal #52AFAB. Soft rounded sans-serif Berth wordmark.

name: Premium editorial
direction: Premium editorial typographic identity. The logo is the word Berth in a beautiful custom contemporary serif with restrained nautical personality. Sculpt the B counter into a subtle docking slot and give the r and t distinctive refined details. Mostly near-black #1D2933, a tiny muted copper #B57C58 accent if useful. No separate illustration. Exceptionally elegant spacing and readable lettering.

name: Futuristic
direction: Restrained futuristic infrastructure identity. A compact orbital docking mark: a broken circular ring shelters a small rounded rectangular device at one precise docking point, with a single electric-violet connector. Strong flat silhouette, asymmetry, clean negative space. Midnight #1E2047 and electric violet #7956EC. Custom extended sans-serif Berth wordmark. No glow, gradients, or science-fiction scenery.
